dict.string: During a round you start, Manhunt Crews records your crew phone's GPS route — including while the screen is locked — to release scheduled location pings to the other crew and to show both routes and distances after the round. Tracking stops when the round ends.

Manhunt Crews only tracks during a round you explicitly start. Your exact route stays hidden from the other crew while playing; they receive scheduled pings only. Both routes are shown to the two operators after the round.
Precise location is needed during a round so scheduled pings and route distances are accurate. Approximate locations are never released as precise pings.
The seeking crew takes an in-app photo to claim a catch. The hiding crew's operator reviews it to confirm or reject. Photos may include bystanders; location metadata is removed.
Development builds connect to the Manhunt Crews server running on your local network.
